description: This source file implements the CopyPasteManager class, which manages clipboard copy and paste operations, including validation and regex-based parsing of expressions for a calculator application. It defines character sets, regex patterns, and methods for handling clipboard content, expression validation, operand extraction, and length/value calculations for different calculator modes.

classes.name: CopyPasteManager
classes.description: Manages clipboard copy and paste operations, expression validation, and operand parsing for calculator modes.

methods.name: CopyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies a string to the system clipboard.

methods.name: GetStringToPaste
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves and validates text from the clipboard based on calculator mode and settings.

methods.name: HasStringToPaste
methods.description: Checks if the clipboard contains text data.

methods.name: ValidatePasteExpression
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes pasted expressions, returning either the original text or a 'NoOp' error string.

methods.name: ExtractOperands
methods.description: Extracts individual operands from a pasted expression string based on calculator mode.

methods.name: ExpressionRegExMatch
methods.description: Checks if operands match regex patterns for the current mode and validates length and value constraints.

methods.name: GetMaxOperandLengthAndValue
methods.description: Calculates maximum operand length and value based on mode, bit length, and number base.

methods.name: SanitizeOperand
methods.description: Removes unwanted characters from an operand string.

methods.name: TryOperandToULL
methods.description: Attempts to convert an operand string to an unsigned long long integer based on number base.

methods.name: OperandLength
methods.description: Calculates the length of an operand considering mode-specific rules.

methods.name: StandardScientificOperandLength
methods.description: Calculates operand length for standard and scientific modes, excluding decimal points and exponents.

methods.name: ProgrammerOperandLength
methods.description: Calculates operand length for programmer mode, considering prefixes, suffixes, and bit length.

methods.name: RemoveUnwantedCharsFromString
methods.description: Removes whitespace, punctuation, and currency symbols from input string.

methods.name: IsErrorMessage
methods.description: Checks if a message string equals the predefined error message.
